gen-dafont-nulshock-gf-karla: Nulshock stretches out in wide, spacious letters, every stroke drawn as one unshaded outline. Karla follows with a stocky sans body and a gaping c, which keeps a long page friendly and easy going.
gen-dafont-nulshock-gf-khula: Wide, techy and bold. Khula takes over below with a plain sans body whose curves hold their mouths open, and that open friendliness is the pair's strongest quality against Nulshock's stretched outline.
gen-dafont-nulshock-gf-matangi: Nulshock spaces its stretched, unshaded outline letters far apart. Matangi's hefty, twine-like strokes and open rounds feel solid and warm beside that wiry, technical heading, like soft rope next to a metal frame.
gen-dafont-nulshock-gf-michroma: Stretched, technical, outlined. Michroma gives each sans-serif letter a wide berth and leaves daylight in its curves, so it echoes Nulshock's spacious tracking while the body stays sturdier on the page.
gen-dafont-nulshock-gf-miriam-libre: Approachable describes Miriam Libre, a sans-serif drawn with wire-like strokes and a generously open s, set under the stretched, technical Nulshock. They sit together with a firm, friendly footing.
gen-dafont-nulshock-gf-mozilla-headline: Mozilla Headline brings big-bodied letters and a splayed c terminal. Nulshock's stretched, spacious outline stands above that plain sans body, and its strokes curve without any pinching, giving the page a crisp, technical top.
gen-dafont-nulshock-gf-mozilla-text: Nulshock draws its stretched letters with one steady, unshaded outline and no brush-style swell anywhere. And Mozilla Text, a sans-serif with flared terminals and sturdy bodies, gives that heading a solid partner underneath.
gen-dafont-nulshock-gf-nobile: Nulshock draws every curve as thick as its straight stems, stretched wide with generous spacing and no shading at all. Nobile's open mouths and tight gap between lowercase and capitals give the pair its crisp, tidy edge.
gen-dafont-nulshock-gf-noto-sans-adlam: Noto Sans Adlam keeps its curve endings well apart, with rounded c, s and z standing full. Noto Sans Adlam then makes a spacious partner for Nulshock, whose stout, stretched outline does best in a large, brief heading.
gen-dafont-nulshock-gf-noto-sans-anatoli: Modern and quiet, Noto Sans Anatolian Hieroglyphs points its terminals outward and lifts its lowercase near cap height. Noto Sans Anatolian Hieroglyphs against Nulshock's solder-smooth, stretched outline makes a pair whose strongest quality is crisp, mechanical order.
